title: Lumen
about: A quieter home for notes, ideas, and things taking shape. This round explores the opening, the plans, and the navigation. Try the pages, like what is worth keeping, and pick what feels right.

decisions.title: The first impression
decisions.question: How should Lumen invite someone to start?

options.name: A simple welcome
options.idea: One idea, a little breathing room, and a way in.

options.name: Possibilities first
options.idea: A few sample collections make the blank page feel less blank.
options.why: Specific examples help people find their own starting point.

options.name: A window inside
options.idea: An open notebook sits beside the invitation.
options.why: See the product before deciding to try it.

options.name: Start a space
options.idea: An email field makes the next step feel immediate.
options.tradeoff: Asks for a commitment before exploring.

options.name: Try a thought
options.idea: Write a real note in the opening, without signing up.
options.why: The first useful moment happens here.
options.tradeoff: More to interact with on a small screen.

options.name: Follow an idea
options.idea: Three small scenes show a thought becoming something worth keeping.
options.tradeoff: A longer path to the first action.

decisions.title: Finding a plan
decisions.question: What makes it easiest to choose the right amount of space?

options.name: Three plans
options.idea: Three straightforward plans, with Plus gently emphasized.

options.name: A use for each
options.idea: Each plan opens with the kind of work it makes room for.

options.name: Side by side
options.idea: A single table lines up the practical differences.

options.name: Start with you
options.idea: Choose how you work, then see one suggested plan.
options.tradeoff: The full comparison takes another click.

decisions.title: Getting around
decisions.question: How much should the navigation put within reach?

options.name: Just the essentials
options.idea: The name, the main pages, and a place to start.

options.name: A familiar shelf
options.idea: Links sit beside the name on a softly tinted bar.

options.name: Find a note
options.idea: Search takes the center, for someone already at home here.
options.tradeoff: Less guidance for a first visit.

questions.question: Which billing period should appear first?
questions.why: Annual saves a little; monthly is simpler to understand.
